string.text: Not Left 4 Dead
Mod Enabled
Master toggle to enable or disable Not Left 4 Dead battle aftermath survivor spawns.
Survivor Relation Bonus
Relation bonus awarded with the survivor upon rescuing and recruiting them (default: 100).
Use Custom Name & Epithet Pool
When enabled, survivors receive culture-appropriate gritty names and survivor epithets (defined in config.json).
Spawn & Battle Size
Minimum Base Spawn Chance
Base probability of finding a survivor in the smallest qualifying battle (default: 15%).
Guaranteed Casualty Threshold
Total battle casualties (killed + wounded) at which survivor discovery chance reaches 100% (default: 1500).
Spawn Chance Multiplier
Overall multiplier applied to survivor spawn probability calculation.
Winning Side Survivor Weight
Probability that a survivor originates from the winning army instead of the defeated side when both sides had Lords (default: 35%).
Companion & Pool Rules
Allow Exceeding Companion Limit
If enabled, you can recruit battlefield survivors even if your clan has reached its companion capacity.
Max Unrecruited Survivors (World FIFO Cap)
Maximum number of unrecruited survivors wandering the realm. Spawning a new survivor past this limit removes the oldest unrecruited survivor (default: 5).
Initial Wounded HP Ratio Min
Minimum initial health ratio for newly spawned wounded survivors (default: 15%).
Initial Wounded HP Ratio Max
Maximum initial health ratio for newly spawned wounded survivors (default: 20%).
Force Spawn (Debug)
Forces a survivor to spawn after ANY qualifying battle regardless of size or probability.

{HERO_NAME} fought under the banner of {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} ({SURVIVOR_FACTION_NAME}) in a brutal clash against {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} ({ENEMY_FACTION_NAME}) that claimed {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} casualties. Left for dead in the wreckage, {HERO_NAME} was rescued by {PLAYER_LINK}.

I was a loyal retainer of {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}. When {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} forces crashed upon us, my lord fled without a second thought, leaving me bleeding among the dead. For {HOURS_SINCE_BATTLE} hours I have been lying here waiting for the vultures.

Am I... dead? Why does the sky still burn red? Are you an angel sent to take my soul, or truly of the living? When {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} struck their banner and ran, I thought {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} had slaughtered us all...

Curse {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} and that cowardly bloodline! The highborn galloped away to safety while throwing us footmen as meat shields before {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} and the {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} axes! I will never forget that treason as long as blood pumps in my veins!

Hehehe... Listen to them, the crows are still laughing! {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} promised us songs and glory, did they not? So this is the honor of {SURVIVOR_FACTION_NAME}: to be carved into a feast for {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} scavengers! All lies... nothing but rotting lies!

The sound... it will not stop. The {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} war horns, the screaming horses trampling into our chests. My blade shattered in my hand and everything went black. {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} left us here in the jaws of hell, with nothing left in my fist but broken steel.

Stay back! Do not touch me! Are you one of {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s scavenging jackals come to strip the dead? Ah... no, your eyes are different. Merciful heavens... Please, I have no strength left to bleed, I beg of you, help me.

Why me? My brothers, my comrades... every one of them perished beneath {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s spears. They threw their bodies forward so {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s standard would not touch the mud. Why am I still breathing while they lie cold beneath the grass?

Well, give credit where it is due: {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s thoroughbred stallion was worth every silver coin! The moment {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} sounded the charge, my lord galloped off so fast he left his own dust behind! Leaving us poor foot sloggers to stitch our guts in the dirt.

A hand... a living, warm hand. For {HOURS_SINCE_BATTLE} hours I have shivered in this frozen mud. When {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} fled to save their own neck without looking back, I thought this ditch was my grave. The heavens must have sent you...

Raise the shields! {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s cavalry broke through, close the ranks! Ha... wh-where am I? Is the slaughter done? Where are {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s banners? Did they... did they leave us behind to rot?

Tear it away! May {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s fine sigil drown in this filth! I let steel pierce my flesh for a commander who turned tail and fled the first glimpse of {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} axes. Never again will I bleed for a noble's craven pride!

I refused to close my eyes. Pure spite kept my heart beating! Spite against {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} who cut me down, and spite against {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} who left me in the mud to decay. I will not yield this breath so easily!

We broke {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s army and won the field, yet look at me! While {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s host rushed ahead in pursuit of glory, they left their wounded bleeding in the grass like slaughtered cattle. What kind of victory is this?

We drove {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} host into the dirt, but {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} cared only about pillaging the baggage train! The wagons full of silver mattered more than the men who bled to break the line.

The horns sounded our triumph over {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}, yet the cheers grew faint in the distance while I lay pinned under my dead warhorse. Not a single squire from {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s retinue bothered to comb the ditch.

Sing songs of our great triumph over {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}, bard! Just make sure to mention how the glorious {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} celebrated by letting their best front-rankers choke on battlefield flies!

When {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} broke, I heard our lads shouting victory. In my fever, I thought those voices were ghosts calling me across the river. {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} marched right past me... I could not even raise an arm to signal.

For {HOURS_SINCE_BATTLE} hours since {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} was routed, I have stared at the clouds wondering if anyone would return. {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s campfires flickered miles away, while we the wounded were cast aside like empty quivers.

'{SURVIVOR_FACTION_NAME} remembers its heroes,' they said! We shattered {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s charge with our bodies, and for that sacrifice {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} abandoned us to the night chill without water or a bandage.

I took two spear points to the chest taking down {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s banner bearer. We won, yet when I collapsed in exhaustion, {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s vanguard trampled right over me in their rush to chase the runners.

The battle with {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} is done, but the battle for life never stops. {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} left us behind, and I have been keeping camp scavengers off my throat with this jagged spear shaft.
I bled to give {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} that grand triumph over {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME}. If winning only buys you a slow death in the mud, then my loyalty to high lords died on this field.
Our transport ship splintered into matchwood when {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} rams struck. I washed ashore clinging to a broken spar after hours adrift in the freezing surf.

The naval skirmish against {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} fleet was a bloodbath. When our galley went down, I was dragged under by drowning men and barely clawed my way up onto these rocky shores.

Curse {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}! When {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s war dromons set our fleet ablaze, my lord caught the offshore wind and sailed away, never even lowering a jolly boat for those of us struggling in the surf!

Cough... my throat burns like quicklime. Is the tide rising again? The sea was red with blood when {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} fire arrows hit our decks. {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} vanished into the morning fog and left us to drown.

Heavy mail is a death sentence at sea. I had to strip my dead comrade's belt to stay afloat when {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s war galleys shattered our hull. The gods alone know how I crawled past these razor rocks.

The cold... the sea gnaws at your bones deeper than any blade. For {HOURS_SINCE_BATTLE} hours I drifted among the wreckage of {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s sunken pride. Your presence is the first warmth I have felt since the hulls cracked.
What actually happened here? Tell me of the battle.
Who are you really? What is your story?
What happened to you? How bad are your wounds?

{SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s {SURVIVOR_FACTION_NAME} host clashed fiercely with {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} forces near {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. The battle was a slaughter from the start, leaving {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} dead and wounded before {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} sounded the retreat and abandoned the fallen.

We engaged {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} ({ENEMY_FACTION_NAME}) under the command of {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} right outside {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. When our center collapsed under {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s charge, {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} ordered an immediate rout, leaving {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} men behind to be slaughtered.

Near the walls of {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}, {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} and {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} fought a brutal engagement. Over {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} souls fell in the carnage, and when defeat became certain, {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} fled without looking back.

{ENEMY_LORD_NAME} masked their cavalry behind the hills near {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. While an unending arrow storm pinned {SURVIVOR_FACTION_NAME}'s line down, their flank crashed into us like a tidal wave. Over {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} perished as {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} fled the field.

The river crossing approaching {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME} became a slaughter pen. {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} forced us across the choke point, straight into {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s spears. The water ran red with {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} dead before our banners broke and ran.

Heavy rains turned the valley outside {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME} into a quagmire. Our boots sank to the shins while {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME}'s skirmishers cut us down at will. {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} cut their horse free and abandoned {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} stranded soldiers.

{ENEMY_LORD_NAME} outmaneuvered {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s formations on the plains of {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. By midday we were encircled from both wings. Over {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} bodies piled up before the broken remnant panicked and scattered into the woods.

At first light near {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}, {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} war horns caught our camp unprepared. {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s shock troops ripped through the tents before shields could be locked. {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} rode away into the fog, leaving {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} casualties behind.

{SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} completely crushed {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} army near {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. Though we won, it cost {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} casualties, and {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} marched off with the plunder while leaving crippled veterans behind in the mud.

It was a glorious triumph over {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} forces outside {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. But glory has a price of {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} casualties, and {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} cared more for the spoils than collecting the wounded.

We broke {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} ({ENEMY_FACTION_NAME}) in a decisive struggle near {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. Total casualties reached {BATTLE_CASUALTIES}, but {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s pursuit was so reckless that the rearguard was entirely forgotten.

{SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s heavy cavalry smashed clean through {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s lines outside {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. We carried the day, but {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} men fell in the initial collision. When our horsemen chased the fleeing rout, the wounded infantry were left behind without food or water.

We held the high ridge overlooking {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME} against {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s repeated assaults. The clash cost {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} casualties before {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} broke. But fearing fresh enemy reinforcements, {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} sounded a forced march, abandoning any soldier too weak to walk.

{SURVIVOR_FACTION_NAME} forces led by {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} overran {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s encampment outside {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. Although {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} men fell in the brutal melee, the army fell upon the loot like starved wolves, leaving the crippled groaning in the dirt.

We held the bridge near {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME} against all odds, turning back {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s superior numbers. Over {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} fell on both sides. Once {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} retreated, {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} crossed the river to march on the city, leaving our wounded bleeding upon the bloodied stones.

Our flank maneuver broke {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s formation in the fields by {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. The butcher's bill was steep at {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} casualties. {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} drove the army hard in pursuit, never pausing to look back at the broken men lying in the furrow.

I am {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}. I swung a smith's hammer in {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME} until heavy taxes broke my master's forge. Levied into {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s host to pay our debts, I learned that {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} steel cuts just as deep whether held by a noble or a smith.

They call me {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}. I tracked wolves and game through the wilderness near {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. My scout reports warned {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} of the trap, but highborn arrogance never listens to a common {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} woodsman.

My name is {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}. For seasons I guarded merchant pack mules in and out of {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. Seeking steady silver, I pledged my {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} blade to {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s banner, only to be repaid with abandonment in this slaughterhouse.

I am {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}. Raiders put my family's homestead outside {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME} to the torch. Seeking vengeance, I took up {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} arms under {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}, only to find that lords care nothing for the blood of their avengers.

They knew me as {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME} in the fighting pits of {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. When my debts grew too steep, {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} bought out my contract to put a seasoned {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} brawler in the front rank. It seems dying in the mud pays the same as the arena.

I was christened {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}, born a disowned bastard in the back alleys of {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. I picked up {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} mail and marched with {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} hoping to win a name and estate of my own. All I won was a ditch full of blood.

I am {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}. I built siege ladders and ballistas in {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. When infantry numbers dwindled, {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} shoved a shield into my hands and ordered a {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} carpenter to hold against charging cavalry.

They call me {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}. I practiced bone-setting and apothecary craft in {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. I spent all afternoon binding {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} wounds for {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}, yet the moment an iron point pierced my own side, they rode off and left the healer to rot.

My name is {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}. I poached deer around {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME} until {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} offered me the king's pardon in exchange for {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} skirmish service. Outlaws have more honor than lords: at least highwaymen do not leave their own to die.

I am {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}. Three of us, brothers and kin, marched out of {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME} wearing matching {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} kit to fight for {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}. The other two lie cold in that field over there, and our lord did not even look back.

They call me {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}. I threw rowdy drunkards out of taverns in {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME} until I lost a drunken dice roll to one of {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s recruiters. One bad toss brought a {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} brawler to this bloody ditch.

My name is {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}, born to proud {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} blood in {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. I swore on holy iron to guard {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s personal standard. I stood over our fallen banner until an axe broke my collarbone; my reward was to be forgotten by the very lord I shielded.

I took a severe blow during {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s assault. For {HOURS_SINCE_BATTLE} hours I lay pinned beneath corpses and shattered shields, listening to looters while {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s banners vanished over the ridge.

A dying warhorse collapsed across my chest when {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s line broke. Three ribs are cracked and every breath feels like boiling oil, but the bones are holding. With water and rest, I will stand upright again.

A barbed {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} arrow took me deep in the left shoulder. I snapped the shaft off with my teeth while playing dead. The point is still in the flesh, but the bleeding has slowed to a trickle.

A rider from {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s retinue clipped my helm with an iron mace. My vision was clouded with black spots and blood ran into my eyes, but my skull did not crack. I have lived on rainwater licking off grass.

The {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} cavalry trampled our line into the mud. For {HOURS_SINCE_BATTLE} hours I dragged my twisted knee across the field, keeping silent while corpse strippers searched pockets only paces away.

A great axe split my oak shield in two and bit deep into my forearm. I managed to cauterize the worst tear with a smoldering torch end from a burned supply cart. My fingers still move; I can hold a sword.
A spear thrust grazed along my ribs when {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s flank buckled. It tore through leather and mail, leaving a bloody trench. The wound is clean enough, though it throbs with every step.

Rusty iron and ditch water gave me a burning fever. My canteen was crushed hours ago, and thirst has been clawing at my throat worse than {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s blades. Give me a drink, and my strength will return.

When {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} infantry swept through to finish off the fallen, I smeared blood across my neck and lay motionless under two dead comrades. My legs are bruised and numb, but no vitals were pierced.

A heavy bolt punched through my thigh during the opening volley against {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}. I crawled into a dry culvert to dress the tear with strips from my cloak. The muscle is stiff, but the bone is unbroken.
You arrived before the scavengers could finish what the blades started. I will never forget this mercy (Relation +{SURVIVOR_RELATION}). Take me with you, and my steel is pledged to your cause.

By the heavens, you pulled me from the jaws of the grave! A life for a life (Relation +{SURVIVOR_RELATION}). Give me a place in your ranks, and I swear to stand between you and any blade that dares strike your way!
I know what it means to be abandoned, and I know what a true commander looks like (Relation +{SURVIVOR_RELATION}). I can still march and I can still kill. Lead the way, and I will earn my keep.

I had given up on ever seeing another sunrise. Your kindness has restored my spirit (Relation +{SURVIVOR_RELATION}). Please, do not leave me to the mercy of this barren field. Take me with your company.

My hands are shaking... but my heart is resolute (Relation +{SURVIVOR_RELATION}). You risked coming into this charnel ground to pull out a stranger. If you will have me, I will follow your banner anywhere.
I have seen how cheaply noble lords treat blood. You value life, and that is a leader worth dying for (Relation +{SURVIVOR_RELATION}). Let me rise, captain. My sword hand is yours.
You found me just in time. I will never forget this mercy (Relation +{SURVIVOR_RELATION}). Take me with you, and my blade is yours.
Agreed. Rise and join my company.
You must find your own way to the nearest town.
Thank you, captain. I live to fight another day under your banner.
As you wish... I will try to make my way to {TARGET_TOWN_NAME} on foot.
I haven't forgotten how you pulled me from the jaws of death, and I never will, captain. I am ready to join your ranks for good.
Certainly, we will accomplish great things together. Come with me.
Unfortunately, I still have no place for you right now.
An honor, captain! Let us march.
Understood. I will wait here in the tavern until you have need of me.
{FIRST_NAME} {EPITHET}
Battle Aftermath ({ATTACKER} vs {DEFENDER})
Among the debris and fallen soldiers, you hear a faint groan... A survivor clings to life!
{HERO_NAME} has joined your party as a loyal companion.
{HERO_NAME} has been escorted to {TARGET_TOWN_NAME}. You can find them in the local tavern.
{SURVIVOR_NAME} has left your service due to inactivity or world cap limits.
